summary120: Watchlist civic-letter asset: real app code, unproven paid demand, deliverability, and legal posture.
directive: Operator must validate whether this is a business pitch or personal/research asset before investible status.
authority: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

methods: Read existing planning soul and current implementation files.
Tagged repo and dispatch facts as evidence.
Tagged every external market or finance claim as assumption because network access was disabled.

planningMethod: Bottom-up, validation-gated EIR plan using current repo implementation as product evidence and workspace-only assumptions for market sizing.

customer.definition: US residents with one concrete civic concern who need official targeting, legal/regulatory research, drafting, and delivery help [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
customer.buyer: Citizen sender, not the government official [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md]
unvalidated: Repeat purchase frequency [assumption: no cohort data in repo]
Tolerance for AI-assisted drafting [assumption: no user research in repo]

market.tam: $75,000,000 annual transaction value from 5,000,000 paid campaigns times $15 AOV [assumption: workspace-only bottom-up scenario]
market.sam: $900,000 annual serviceable revenue from 50,000 reachable early users times 1.2 campaigns times $15 AOV [assumption: operator-scale launch model]
market.som: $72,000 annual revenue from 4,800 campaigns times $15 AOV by 2027-06-30 [assumption: validation target based on planning scale]

streams: Future API or organization access only after citizen loop validation [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md]
businessModel.marginPosture: Prior soul claimed 88% to 92% or 91% gross margin, but repo has no production cost proof [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md; .planning/PROJECT.md]

revenueAssumptions: Average order value remains $15 because current tiers are $5, $15, and $25 [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/payments.ts]
2027 base paid campaigns reach 4,800, producing $72,000 revenue at $15 AOV [assumption: 400 per month times 12 months]
Paid conversion reaches 3% before scale spend [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
costAssumptions: Variable cost modeled at 10% of revenue until measured [assumption: conservative workspace-only model]
DigitalOcean backend host is about $96 per month in prior planning [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; .planning/existing-state.md]
Prior max burn was listed as $132.50 per month but is unverified operationally [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
sensitivityTests: Downside demand: 100 paid campaigns at $15 AOV equals $1,500 revenue [assumption: failed launch case]
Delivery failure: 20% bounce/refund rate materially damages trust and margin [assumption: government inbox risk]
CAC pressure: $20 paid CAC against $15 AOV is structurally unprofitable [assumption: paid-channel stress test]

alternatives: Manual email or phone calls are free substitutes [assumption: obvious user alternative]
Resistbot is the closest named civic-letter substitute [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
Quorum and VoterVoice are named enterprise advocacy incumbents [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
Change.org is a petition substitute [assumption: general market knowledge, not network verified]

holes: No paid demand evidence in repo [evidence: no production revenue/user files found]
Government deliverability and recipient tolerance are unproven [assumption: inbox and spam-risk basis]
Legal/trust posture is unresolved, including CAN-SPAM contradiction [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; apps/web/app/terms/page.tsx]
Local official data may be stale or expensive [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
mitigations: Paid concierge beta before scale [assumption: validation method]
Bounce gates, opt-out enforcement, Postmark, SPF/DKIM/DMARC [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/delivery.ts; scripts/setup-dns.md]
Moderation, citation verification, audit logs, no-legal-advice language [evidence: apps/api/src/lib/moderation.ts; apps/worker/src/lib/legal/citation-verifier.ts; apps/web/app/terms/page.tsx]
Operator ruling before investible posture [evidence: user dispatch]
residualRisks: Users may not pay even if the product works [assumption: market-risk basis]
Officials may ignore or block AI-assisted letters [assumption: recipient-risk basis]
The opportunity may top out as a useful small tool, not a venture-scale business [assumption: financial model]

strategy: Keep scope narrow: prove paid citizen campaigns, citation reliability, deliverability, and operator workload before adding public pages, organization API, or paid acquisition.

goToMarket.firstWedge: Hand-recruited civic pain cohorts before SEO [assumption: Watchlist validation sequence]
goToMarket.first100: First 100 paid or explicitly comped letter attempts manually recruited and monitored [assumption: validation batch]
channels: Later SEO from public campaign pages only after moderation and privacy validation [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md]

operatorWorkflow.routine: Review flagged submissions, monitor treasury, watch bounces, handle opt-outs and refunds [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/admin.ts; apps/worker/src/agents/delivery.ts]
operatorWorkflow.constraint: One-operator workflow remains an unvalidated hypothesis [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md]

constraints: Registry Watchlist status and personal/research asset note [evidence: user dispatch]
No network research; external market claims are assumptions [evidence: user dispatch]
Political speech, privacy, legal-adjacent content, AI disclosure, and official opt-outs require conservative posture [evidence: apps/web/app/privacy/page.tsx; apps/web/app/terms/page.tsx]
metrics: Federal/state coverage target 95% and local coverage target 60% [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
Refund, chargeback, bounce, complaint, and response rates [assumption: beta scorecard]

aiWorkGovernance.citationPolicy: Drafter is instructed to use only provided citations; researcher verifies and strips unverified citations [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/drafter.ts; apps/worker/src/agents/researcher.ts]
aiWorkGovernance.moderation: Threats and risky content are blocked or flagged before the pipeline [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/submissions.ts; apps/api/src/lib/moderation.ts]

unknowns: Whether brooks-history is the intended public project identity or CivicState should remain the product name [evidence: user dispatch; .planning/PROJECT.md]
Whether operator wants a business pitch [evidence: user dispatch]
Whether live provider credentials and production infrastructure exist [assumption: not visible in repo]
Whether legal counsel approves current disclaimers [assumption: no counsel memo in repo]
